exitCodes.meaning: The reword completed; the payload carries the branch's new head oid. The commit was rebuilt with its original tree and parents, and any descendants were replayed onto it.
Invalid arguments — reword requires exactly one positional argument <commit> and one --message <message>; an unknown, duplicated, or value-missing flag; or both --sign and --no-sign.
The reword could not be completed for a reason the other codes do not name — an unknown commit, a commit not on the caller's branch, an already-matching message, or a signing failure among them.
Blocked on conflicts (blocked_on_conflicts) — the index already held unmerged entries, or the descendant cherry-pick could not apply cleanly and is left in progress, resumable.

flags.help: The commit's new message, passed as a flag — GIT_EDITOR is never invoked.
Never sign, even when commit.gpgsign is true.
Sign the rebuilt commit and the replayed descendants, even when commit.gpgsign is false.

summary: Rewrite one commit's message without invoking an editor.
